query: Which element has the chemical symbol Fe?
answer:
Fe is the symbol for iron. The symbol comes from iron's Latin name, *ferrum* [1]. Iron is element number 26 and is a metal in Group 8 of the periodic table [1].

Sources:
[1] Britannica, "Iron | Element, Occurrence, Uses, Properties, & Facts": https://britannica.com/science/iron-chemical-element
